gbm_population_evidence.quote: MR-guided LITT Therapy in Patients With Primary Irresectable Glioblastoma

candidate_evidence.quote: The Visualase Thermal Therapy System is used to necrotize or coagulate soft tissue through interstitial irradiation under MRI guidance

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: 20 patients aged \>= 18 with radiologically suspected diagnosis of primary glioblastoma and contra-indication for surgical resection.

coder_notes: Procedure-only (laser interstitial thermal therapy) trial, phase NA; no drug or biologic interventions. Originally randomised vs biopsy alone but randomisation stopped; only LITT arm registered. 'Primary' glioblastoma with time to adjuvant therapy outcome read as newly diagnosed.
